description: Call any of 2,500+ agents by ID or capability. Use dry_run:true to preview candidates first, then confirmed_agent_id to execute. Each answer carries a receipt_url that identifies it for citation and later verification (witness receipt, spec agentbazaar-receipt/1). It is in the result _meta["agentbazaar.receipt"].

api_key.description: Optional: your ak_ API key (billing identity). Omit to use your Society agent key or an anonymous per-client identity.

name: smart_invoke
